seoTitle: Jasper Jiarui Lou — CS, Machine Learning & Agent Systems
seoDescription: Personal research and engineering portfolio of Jasper Jiarui Lou: machine learning, agent systems, optimization, academic planning, and applied AI infrastructure.

sections.lead: I document how I learn, build, test, and revise research-oriented software — from machine learning and optimization to agent environments and applied AI systems.
sections.aside: CS student at CUHK-Shenzhen. My current research direction centers on machine learning, with optimization, probability, and agent systems as supporting interests.

sections.intro: I keep iterating on Holistic Assistant and CUHKSZ MicroWorld: one turns curriculum evidence into editable academic plans; the other turns a campus world into a spatial, time-aware agent evaluation environment.
These notes preserve what a project or idea looked like at the time. For current implementation details, the project pages and repositories take priority.
